loop_verdict.oob_fix: QkGemm B-tile staging had no col guard: last partial block read cache slots past TMAX (slots 98..111 of a 98-deep cache). Small overruns silently hit the next slot's memory (N=13 ran, wrong-but-mapped); large overruns past the last slot faulted -> DEVICE_LOST at the first embed replay. Non-monotonic signature (96/112/128 run, 98/104/108/174 crash) = multiples-of-16 have no partial block. Fixed with an N-guard staging zeros; all MAXCTX 32..174 run clean.
loop_verdict.e2e_quality: 70-token 84*3/2 prompt, max-new 96: hybrid 59 tokens vs baseline 58, both EOS-stopped, both decode to '.../2=126. Final just number...' + '126<|im_end|>' (has126 TRUE both). Top-1 identical through step 24; step-0 top-5 order identical (values within ~1.2 on ~24-magnitude logits, fp16-vs-fp32 path noise); step-25 near-tie flip (1534 vs 12204, gap 0.24 = 0.9%) reroutes the tail, which re-converges to 126. Documented near-tie class, not structural divergence — the old L3 structural divergence is gone.
loop_verdict.timing: AINFER_PROFILE=1, same 70+8 run: attn_layer med 1.195 ms hybrid vs 0.959 ms scan (+25%). Linear 1.031 vs 1.030 (unchanged), tail 2.31 vs 2.37. Attention is ~24% of a decode step (16x0.96 of ~67 ms), so even a 2.5x attention win would net ~13% — but at T~78 hybrid PAYS ~23 launches+barriers per full layer vs ~5 for scan, and launch tax dominates. Synthetic 2.5x was measured @4K; break-even is somewhere in the hundreds-to-thousands.
loop_verdict.decision: DEFER for the decode loop; scan stays the default. GEMM-form (QkGemm DPAS + vector softmax) redirects to chunked prefill, where per-launch work is 256x larger and launch tax amortizes. Hybrid path stays env-gated (AINFER_ATTN=hybrid) as the experimental vehicle for that line.
